tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Open a new issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Fetch a single issue by number from a repository.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in a GitHub repository, optionally filtered by state.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Edit or close an existing issue in a repository.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search issues and pull requests across repositories by free-text query.

tools.name: add_issue_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing issue or pull request.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Open a new pull request from a head branch into a base branch.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Fetch a single pull request by number, including its status.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository by state.

tools.name: merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge an open pull request into its base branch.

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from a GitHub repository at a ref.

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Commit a new or changed file to a repository branch.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search source code across GitHub repositories by query.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List recent commits on a repository branch.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a repository from a base ref.
